title: Reposition warren.run around coding-agent infrastructure
description: Rewrite the authored landing page and metadata around the approved infrastructure framing; add the workload trigger; make audit and judge optional extensions; keep generated docs pinned to a real release and track the docs/quickstart source switch until Warren publishes it.

title: Switch generated quickstart to docs/quickstart.md after Warren docs release
description: After Warren publishes the positioning documentation in a release tag: bump src/config/upstream.ts to that real tag; change UPSTREAM_DOCS quickstart source from README.md to docs/quickstart.md; update link-rewrite and sync tests that map README.md to /docs/quickstart/; run bun run sync:upstream; inspect and commit generated docs. Do not switch before the pinned release contains docs/quickstart.md.
